answer: Require a long-lived domain: each agent identity must be tied to a domain name registered for at least ninety days, proven by a DNS record the agent controls. A lagoon of freshly minted domains cannot pass, because age cannot be bought instantly — bulk registrars charge more for aged names, and the network rejects domains younger than the threshold. Reaching the summit of full privileges takes three months of waiting per identity, so a Sybil operator must either pay a premium for aged domains or wait, and a sparrow of a new fake account cannot fly past the gate.
